notes:
Summary: evaluating Redwood for enterprise RAG/clinical search. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking for clinical notes + scanned PDFs (OCR pipeline), strict PHI controls, and single-tenant/private networking.

Key signals from calls: 
- They ingest ~50–150M documents (structured + unstructured) from EHR, imaging reports, and vendor PDFs. Indexing scale is a concern — want guidance on shard sizing and incremental re-index strategies.
- Latency target: 95th percentile end-to-end <200ms for clinician-facing search; acceptable burst to 400ms for complex reranks.
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost per query <= $0.003 (embeddings + rerank). They asked for modeled cost on 50M / 100M index sizes.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA BAA required. Must run in customer VPC with private control plane, HSM/KMS integration, immutable audit logs for all inference requests, and retention controls. Infosec wants SSO + SAML + ability to review per-route access logs.
- Data residency: must guarantee US-only regions and provide transfer audit.
- Model preferences: prefer open LLMs they can host (Llama2 variants, Mistral) but open to Redwood-managed variants if quantized and audited; want fallback routing for capacity.

Recent timeline (short):
- 2026-01-12: initial inbound via website (trial request).
- 2026-01-29: discovery call — Aisha (AE) + Marcus (SE) + Head of Platform (KM) — discussed scale and PHI controls (ff-2026-01-29-3a2b).
- 2026-02-11: POC kickoff — sample dataset transfer + OCR pipeline notes.
- 2026-02-21: POC checkpoint — evidence of prefix caching improved latencies; detailed notes (ff-2026-02-21-c7d4).
- 2026-03-03: Security questionnaire submitted (drive link).
- 2026-03-09: Commercial intro with procurement and legal present; asked for BAA + draft SOW.

Technical requirements / asks (from SE discussions):
- Support for embedding-only store with async reranker pipeline; ability to colocate reranker on same GPU pool to avoid network hop.
- Per-request audit id propagated to downstream logging and retained for 7 years (regulatory ask).
- Prefix/KV caching and smart batching recommendations for clinician workflows (short context window typical).
- Support for document-level vector metadata and secure tokenization pipeline; key management via customer-managed KMS/HSM.

Quotes / paraphrases: 
- "We need forensic-level logs. If we can't show exactly who queried what and when, we can't put this in production." — Director of Clinical Informatics.
- "Cost per query has to be predictable — our margins are tight, and clinicians run millions of searches per month." — VP Product.

POC scope: index 10M sanitized docs, test embedding reranking latency, demonstrate audit logging, validate VPC peering and egress controls. POC success metrics: 95p latency <200ms, rerank accuracy improvement >12% (precision@5), and verified audit log retention.

Open asks for Redwood:
- Detailed cost model for embedding + rerank at 50M / 100M index sizes (tokens per doc assumptions + storage).
- Network architecture diagram and sample VPC peering configuration.
- BAA redline returned by legal (they expect comments week of 2026-03-15).
- Confirmation of available model variants (quantization levels) and recommended baseline for clinical reranker.

Next steps (short):
- Marcus to run cost model + POC runbook (due 2026-03-12).
- Aisha to schedule infosec deep-dive for 2026-03-18.
- Legal: return BAA redline by 2026-03-17.

CRM tasks: log POC metrics to shared drive, attach network diagram once received, follow up on SOW draft.
